reviews.text:
I received this as a free product and I was sooo excited to try it. The first thing I noticed is how light it feels on the skin. It sinks in so quickly and doesn’t leave any stickiness at all. Even with my sensitive combination skin, it didn’t cause any irritation or breakouts.

After about a week, my skin looked smoother and brighter, and my makeup started going on more evenly. It has this soft, sweet scent that’s really nice but not overpowering. I also love that you only need a few drops, so the bottle is going to last a long time.

It’s one of those products that quietly works in the background and suddenly you realise your skin feels softer and looks healthier. Gonna definitely keep using this one in my routine.
reviews.zh:
我係免費試用品收到呢款，所以好興奮想試。我第一個留意到嘅係佢摸落好輕盈，好快吸收，完全冇黏膩感。即使我係敏感混合皮膚，都冇引起任何刺激或者爆痘。

大約一個星期之後，我嘅皮膚睇落更滑、更明亮，上妝都變得更均勻。佢有種柔和、甜甜嘅香味，好好聞，但唔會太濃。我仲好鍾意只需要幾滴，所以支裝可以用好耐。

呢類產品默默咁喺背後發揮作用，然後你會突然發覺皮膚摸落更軟、睇落更健康。我一定會繼續喺護膚程序入面用佢。

reviews.text:
The ampoule contains both Black Sugar Extract & PHA and feels great on the skin. It’s supposed to “helps smooth out rough skin texture for clear and glowy skin” - I can’t wait to see the results in what I think will take a couple weeks. 

I have sensitive combination skin and the ampoule did NOT break me out, didn’t irritate my skin either. 

It also contains Green Food Complex which is supposed to brighten dull skin. The texture is nice as well. Not sticky.
reviews.zh:
呢款安瓶含有黑糖提取物同 PHA，用落皮膚感覺好好。宣傳話佢「幫助平滑粗糙嘅皮膚質地，令皮膚清透有光澤」——我好期待見到效果，我估要幾個星期。

我嘅皮膚係敏感混合性，安瓶冇令我爆痘，亦冇刺激皮膚。

佢仲含有 Green Food Complex，宣傳話可以提亮暗啞嘅皮膚。質地都好好，唔黏。

reviews.text:
My experience with this ampoule is that it is an extremely gentle on the skin, as a person who has excema quite frequently and has really sensitive skin, this serum didn't irritate my skin at all! 

When opening the container it reminds me of a soft hand sanitizer smell (2020 nostalgia 😭😭) with a sweet touch to it, I couldn't really smell anything from the actual ampoule, so I'm guessing it may be unscented, I'm not sure on that part of it. 

The ampoule gives a soft glow, not at all greasy or oily and it is really lightweight. I've only used it for my night routines 2-3 times a week, and have only used it for under a month. I've seen that my pores have become more small and I can barely feel them as much as before, there's no more dullness in my face and my tan is fading slowly, but my skin tone is becoming patchy (i searched it up and it's mostly part of the process which means it actually exfoliates your skin) and overall my face feels so much softer!! I'm glad I chose this product as my Glow Up Giveaway, its really improving my skin for the better. 

Thank you for reading this xx
reviews.zh:
我有濕疹，皮膚又好敏感，用呢款安瓶嘅體驗係佢對皮膚非常溫和，完全冇刺激我嘅皮膚！

打開容器嗰陣，聞落似一種柔和嘅搓手液味（2020 年嘅懷舊感 😭😭），帶少少甜味，但我冇辦法真係聞到安瓶本身嘅味道，所以我估佢可能冇香味，呢點我唔太確定。

安瓶帶嚟柔和光澤，完全唔油膩，質地好輕盈。我只係每星期晚上用 2 至 3 次，而且用咗唔夠一個月。我見到毛孔收細咗，之前嗰種感覺我幾乎都睇唔到，面上嘅暗啞都冇咗，我嘅曬黑亦慢慢淡咗，不過皮膚色調開始有啲斑駁（我查咗，大多數係過程嘅一部分，即係話佢真係有去角質效果），總括而言，我張面摸落軟好多！！我好開心今次揀咗呢款作為我嘅 Glow Up Giveaway，佢真係令我嘅皮膚有改善。

多謝你睇完呢篇 xx

reviews.text: This product states that it can be used either AM OR PM but the amount applied would be different. Since this ampoule is a high-concentration product that both hydrates as well as has peeling care ingredients, which is what I was wanting mostly as a gentle exfoliation, I chose to use it in the evening. It didn’t leave that sticky feeling after applied and in the morning I did have a nice glow and it definitely showed my skin more hydrated. I wasn’t sure how often i should use it so I applied it every 2nd night and yes it does bring that fresh look. If you’re looking for a non aggressive product that can be incorporated in your skin routine I would definitely recommend this product.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品話早晚都可以用，但用量會有分別。因為呢款安瓶係高濃度產品，有補濕同去角質護理成分，而我最主要想要嘅就係溫和嘅去角質效果，所以我揀咗晚上用。搽完冇黏膩感，而第二朝確實有好靚嘅光澤，皮膚睇落明顯更水潤。我唔肯定應該幾耐用一次，所以我每隔一晚用一次，而佢確實會帶嚟清新嘅感覺。如果你想搵一款唔刺激、可以融入護膚程序嘅產品，我絕對推薦呢款。

reviews.text: I’ve tried many skinfood products over the years and usually like everything. This one was no exception. it’s very watery and not too heavy on the skin, which is great right now during the summer. I feel it absorbs into my skin instead of sitting on top. I’ll try this for a few more weeks and probably keep it in my regimen.
reviews.zh: 我多年嚟試過好多 SKINFOOD 產品，通常都幾鍾意。呢款都冇例外。佢好水、唔會太厚重，夏天而家用好啱。我覺得佢係吸收入皮膚，而唔係浮喺面上。我會再用幾個星期，大概會留喺我嘅護膚程序入面。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Skinfood Black Sugar PHA Ampoule for a few weeks, and it’s become a staple in my evening routine. The PHA (a gentler exfoliant compared to AHA/BHA) works beautifully to smooth out texture without drying out my skin or causing any redness.

The ampoule has a light, hydrating texture that absorbs quickly, and the black sugar extract seems to give an immediate soft glow. My skin feels plumper, more even, and visibly healthier in the morning.

If you’re looking for a mild exfoliating serum that also hydrates and adds radiance, this one is a hidden gem. Bonus: it layers well with other products and doesn’t pill.
reviews.zh:
我用咗 Skinfood Black Sugar PHA Ampoule 幾個星期，已經成為我晚上護膚程序嘅必備產品。PHA（比 AHA/BHA 溫和嘅去角質成分）有效咁平滑質地，又唔會令皮膚乾燥或者泛紅。

安瓶質地輕盈、補濕，吸收快，而黑糖提取物似乎即時帶嚟柔和光澤。第二朝我皮膚感覺更飽滿、更均勻，睇落明顯更健康。

如果你想搵一款溫和去角質、又可以補濕同提亮嘅精華，呢款係一件隱藏寶物。加分位：佢同其他產品疊搽都好好，唔會搓泥。

reviews.text:
It is a good product to add to your weekly skin care plan. 
The ampoule absorbs quickly and makes skin immediatly smoother. 
Its quite efficient and I recommend applying thin layer of it. If you use too much it feels a little bit "blunt" on the skin.
It is not sticky, and even it does not dry your skin, a moisturizer on top of it is a must.
reviews.zh:
呢款係一款好適合加入每星期護膚計劃嘅產品。
安瓶吸收快，令皮膚即時更順滑。
效果都幾好，我建議薄薄咁搽一層。如果用太多，皮膚會有少少悶悶地嘅感覺。
佢唔會黏，即使唔會令皮膚乾，但面上一定要再搽保濕霜。
